general.enabled.description: Enable the NAS service on startup.

general.logger_level.description: Logging verbosity level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR).

general.worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads for handling requests.

general.max_open_files.description: Maximum number of open file descriptors allowed for the service.

general.listen_address.description: Network interface IP address the NAS service will bind to.

general.listen_port.description: Port number the NAS service will listen on.

general.tls.cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (required if TLS is enabled).

general.tls.key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (required if TLS is enabled).

storage.default_path.description: Default storage path for user files when no backend is specified.

storage.backends.description: List of configured storage backends. Each backend defines a distinct storage target.

name.description: Unique identifier for the backend (used in section names).

path.description: Path or URI where this backend’s data resides.

max_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) allowed for this backend.

readonly.description: If true, this backend accepts only read operations.

auth.method.description: Authentication method used by the NAS service.

auth.ldap_base_dn.description: Base DN for LDAP directory searches (required if auth.method=ldap).
